description: SEC Form 4 insider trades in plain English: who (name, role), bought or sold, how many shares, at what price, total value, 10b5-1 plan flag. Market-wide (all US public companies, refreshed every ~2 min) or for one ticker. Free, no account needed. Filter kind=buy for open-market insider purchases.

kind.description: buy = open-market purchase (code P), sell = open-market sale (S), other = grants, exercises, tax withholding, gifts

min_value.description: Minimum transaction value in USD, e.g. 100000

ticker.description: Optional, e.g. NVDA. Omit for the market-wide feed.

name: insider_trades
